title: Junior Engineer
description: **About Minerex Environmental:** Minerex Environmental is a leader in providing specialised environmental services, with a core focus on **dewatering, over-pumping, water treatment**, and **environmental management** for the construction, mining, and pharmaceutical industries. We offer innovative and sustainable solutions to water management challenges, ensuring efficient resource utilisation while minimising environmental impact. Our commitment to excellence and regulatory compliance ensures that we help our clients achieve operational goals while protecting ecosystems and maintaining the highest safety standards. **About the Role** Minerex is looking for an early-career engineer or technician to join our engineering team, working on the development, manufacture and maintenance of electrical control equipment and engineering solutions for the water treatment industry. This is a hands-on role offering the opportunity to develop practical engineering skills while building towards a more specialised role in automation and control systems. Initially, much of your time will be spent fabricating, assembling, wiring, testing and maintaining electrical control equipment. As you develop your experience and understanding of our systems, you will progressively take on greater responsibility for PLC programming, automation, telemetry, data visualisation and the development of new engineering solutions. You will work closely with experienced engineers on a varied mix of workshop activities, software and control system development, research and development, and site-based engineering work. We are interested in people who enjoy practical problem-solving, want to understand how equipment works and are keen to develop their technical skills across both hardware and software. **Key Responsibilities** **Electrical Equipment & Workshop Engineering** * Fabricate, assemble, wire and test electrical control panels, control boxes and associated equipment. * Maintain, repair and modify electrical control equipment and systems. * Install and configure electrical components, including relays, motor starters, sensors, instrumentation and control devices. * Read and work from electrical drawings, wiring diagrams and technical documentation. * Carry out functional testing, fault-finding and troubleshooting. * Assist with improving equipment design, assembly methods, reliability and manufacturing efficiency. * Maintain high standards of workshop organisation, workmanship, safety and quality. **Automation, PLCs & Data Visualisation** * Develop an understanding of the operation and configuration of PLC-based control systems. * Assist with PLC programming, testing, troubleshooting and modification of control systems, progressing towards taking ownership of these activities. * Work with sensors, instrumentation, telemetry equipment and remote monitoring systems. * Develop and maintain system graphics, data graphs, dashboards, synoptics and interactive diagrams. * Assist with integrating hardware, software and communications systems to provide reliable monitoring and control of equipment. * Collect, interpret and present operational data to support equipment testing, fault diagnosis and performance evaluation. * Contribute to the development and improvement of automated processes and control solutions. **Research & Development and Site Support** * Assist with the design, prototyping, fabrication and testing of new equipment and technologies. * Support engineering trials and practical investigations into equipment performance and process improvements. * Assist with the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of equipment on site. * Work with engineering and operational teams to identify issues and develop practical solutions. * Record test results, prepare technical documentation and contribute to engineering reports. * Support the development and continuous improvement of Minerex equipment and systems. **About You** We are looking for someone at the beginning of their engineering career who has a solid technical foundation, a practical mindset and an interest in developing into a broader electrical and automation engineering role. You may be a graduate engineer with some industry experience or a technician looking to expand your skills and progress into automation and controls. You will ideally have: * A relevant qualification in electrical, electronic, automation, mechatronic or another related engineering discipline. * Approximately 1–2 years of relevant practical experience in an engineering, manufacturing, maintenance or technical environment. * An understanding of electrical systems and an interest in electrical controls and automation. * A practical, methodical approach to assembling equipment, testing systems and solving technical problems. * An interest in learning PLC programming, industrial communications and control system development. * Good IT skills and an ability to work with technical software and data. * Good attention to detail and a commitment to producing reliable, high-quality work. * The ability to work both independently and as part of a small engineering team. * A willingness to work in workshop and site environments as required. * A full Irish Driving License is mandatory. **You do not need to be an experienced PLC programmer to apply.** We are looking for someone with the right technical foundation and aptitude who wants to develop these skills as part of their role. **Desirable Experience** Experience in any of the following would be beneficial: * Electrical assembly, wiring, testing or maintenance. * PLCs, industrial automation or control systems. * Sensors, instrumentation, telemetry or remote monitoring. * Programming, scripting or software configuration. * Data visualisation, dashboards, graphing or interactive graphical interfaces. * Reading electrical schematics or working with CAD drawings. * Fabrication, prototyping or mechanical assembly. * Equipment installation, commissioning or fault-finding. **Development & Progression** This role is designed to provide a broad foundation in practical engineering, with opportunities to develop specialist skills in electrical controls and automation. In the initial stages, you will gain hands-on experience manufacturing, assembling, testing and maintaining our equipment. As your technical knowledge develops, you will progressively take on more responsibility for PLC programming, control system configuration, telemetry, data visualisation and automation projects. The longer-term aim is for you to become a capable, independently working engineer or technician who can contribute across both the physical equipment and the software and control systems that operate it. Job Types: Full-time, Permanent Benefits: * Bike to work scheme * Company pension * Free or subsidised travel * On-site parking Ability to commute/relocate: * DUBLIN 24, County Dublin: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred) Language: * English (required) Licence/Certification: * Drivers Licence (required) Work authorisation: * Ireland (preferred) Work Location: In person

title: Junior Graphics Operator
description: ***WHAT WE DO*** Gravity Media deliver an unparalleled range of media services and solutions to clients worldwide utilising outside broadcast trucks, fly-packs and studios spanning the United Kingdom, ROI, Europe, the Middle East, the United States and Australia offering market-leading broadcast, technology, production, and post-production solutions across many of the world’s most-watched live events and entertainment programmes ***.*** ***​*** ***OUR PEOPLE*** We have a passion for problem solving and thoughtful innovation and recognise our collective differences play a huge role our success. Our teams are talented, passionate, dedicated, take pride in their work and support each other. We encourage applications from all backgrounds and are dedicated to attracting and developing talent, empowered through an inclusive culture. All suitably qualified applicants will be considered regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, religion, and age. ***​*** ***LEADERSHIP BEHAVIOURS*** We hold high expectations of our leaders and managers who are responsible for driving the success of our people and the organisation. Our managers give clear communication, lead by example and feed back to foster growth and development of their team members. Management excellence is essential to the company’s success, and effective leadership requires a combination of interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and a commitment to providing a positive and productive work environment. ***​*** ***COMMITMENT TO EQUALITY*** Gravity Media is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome a diverse range of applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request. ​ ***ABOUT THE ROLE*** ***The Role*** We are looking for a Junior Graphics Operator to join our team to generate in-game GFX overlays, lower thirds, countdowns etc across Riot Games Productions. Part of the role will require the Junior GFX Op to prepare and execute immediate GFX requests within Barracks and vMix systems. They will work with the very latest graphics software which will help you to ensure the global GFX output is of the highest quality. The ideal candidate will need to be a clear and confident communicator, able to adapt quickly to on-air changes and remain calm under pressure. Their aim will be to ensure each graphic is accurate and displayed in a timely manner and informs viewers and audiences from all around the world. Having an eye for detail, keeping track of team/player scores and being flexible to edit graphics live as games develop is key. In this role, the GFX Op will be an integral part of the organisation’s Graphics Department and will report to the Production Manager. The position is based in the greater Dublin area. The position may require international travel on occasion. The successful candidate will be assigned to Project Stryker, the Remote Broadcast Centre owned and operated by Riot Games. They will work across the Riot Games’ Esport broadcasts titles. ***​*** ***RESPONSIBILITIES*** * Acting as the Junior GFX Operator ensuring all required show GFX elements and running tests are loaded and accurate to ensure a smooth on-air presentation. * Build graphics and implement load elements into our software packages which include Barracks and Vizrt. * Have a keen eye for detail, to catch errors and ensure all GFX elements are true and accurate. Ensuring they abide by Riot Game brand kits and sponsorship guidelines. * Creating show assets workflows to aid a more efficient broadcast. * Playing GFX calls in a timely and ‘live’ setting. * Monitor scoring and keep a track to forward plan leader boards etc. * Support with the supply various GFX outputs for other departments/feeds/sponsors etc. * Support with the reviewing GFX packages and calls. * Assist with the creation of post-show documentation highlighting any tasks or issues from Graphics. * Refine next day workflows from Producer/Director feedback. * Assist with the loading and prep for next day's broadcast. This position will have access to a live event gallery and, as such, must be greeted with great integrity. Professional and best practice behaviours in this role are essential at all times. *H&S* Adhering to our company H&S policy and ensuring that all company risk assessments are observed where applicable to your role, taking ownership of improvements and escalating concerns where necessary. *ISO* Contribute to the continual improvement of our management systems to ensure compliance with our legal obligations and maintain certification. ​ ***EXPERIENCE PROFILE*** * Ideally have a base knowledge and fandom to Riot Games Products – with a familiarity to game teams, names, logos and in game elements to ensure GFX accuracy. * Experience with Broadcast or HTML browser-source graphics; meticulous with data input. * Experienced in working with Adobe Creative Suite and other software. * Able to generate and build your own GFX overlay elements and bring browser-source graphics in vMix. * Have a base knowledge of trouble shooting to fix errors / frozen renders, lost key or stale data feed. * Basic knowledge of video editing software preferable. ​ ***COMPETENCIES*** * Time management and how-to prioritise workload and asks. * Key communicator – can listen and understand requests without the need for asks to be repeated. * Multitasker – have the dexterity to manage the GFX software and follow show running order while using the talkback panel to communicate with the Director to animate GFX calls etc. * Willingness to learn outside your comfort zone and immerse yourself in learning new technology and software. * Strong computer skills, including working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite apps, and ability to learn and utilise Google business apps. ​ ***QUALIFICATIONS*** * Degree in graphic, motion or interactive design ​ *This job description is a written statement of the essential characteristics of the job and is not intended to be a complete, detailed account of all aspects of the duties involved. Gravity Media is an equal opportunities employer and aims to ensure that no job applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of any protected characteristics.*

title: Lab Quality Assurance Technician
description: **Job Description** **Job Title: Lab Quality Assurance Technician** **Job Type: Full Time (18 Months Contract)** **Shift Pattern: 8 AM to 5 PM (Monday to Friday)** **Location - Littleconnell Brewery** **About The Function** Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. Initial interpretation of results and proactive engagement with the rest of production team to highlight any quality issues. **Experience/skills required:** **Qualifications** * Relevant science degree or equivalent. * Experience working in laboratory setting. **Preferred Experience** * Bachelor/Masters of Science (analytical or microbiology preferred). * 2 years experience working in laboratory environment (regulatory sector preferred). * Core competency in one or more of the following: chromatography (GC/HPLC), chemical Analysis, microbiological analysis and brewing quality control. * Experience in production/manufacturing environment, preferably food, beverage or pharmaceuticals. * Clear understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices and Good Laboratory Practices. Experience using LIMS system, e.g. Harford. **Leadership & Success** * Strong attention to detail to ensure effective and accurate quality analysis. * Confident working independently and as part of a team. * Strong organisation skills with a timely and systematic approach. * Proactive in seeking opportunities to improve work environment, practices and KPIs. * Demonstrates flexible attitudes to new ways of working and site goals. * Applies Manufacturing Excellence tools to drive lab and site performance through continuous improvement. * Demonstrates initiative and self-direction while working as part of a fully autonomous team. **Working with Us** Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one. We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including: Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible. We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team. Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more. Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity. *If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.* ***Recruitment Scam Warning*** *Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.* **Worker Type** Fixed Term Contract (Fixed Term) **Primary Location:** Littleconnell Brewery **Additional Locations :** **Job Posting Start Date** 2026-11-12

title: Leasing Administrator
description: **About Occu** Our superstars are at the heart of everything we do, and we’re driven to being a part of their lives. When we talk about the Occu Experience, we are talking about a culture built on purpose, integrity and high standards. Established in 2019, Occu is Ireland’s leading independent PRS Asset Manager, with over 4,200 residential units under management across 27 locations, and further developments underway. We partner with global institutional investors and operate in a highly governed, asset-backed environment where financial discipline and transparency are critical. At Occu, we're not just about renting homes, we're about creating lifestyles. We work hard on the little touches so our residents can enjoy the big things in life, and we're growing at pace. We’d love to hear from you.***

title: OT Automation Engineer
description: **Industries** Pharmaceutical, dairy / food & beverage and industrial manufacturing **Role Summary** CG Controls delivers industrial automation and IT/OT integration for regulated manufacturing sites across Ireland. We are looking for an Assistant OT Automation Engineer to support the delivery and upkeep of control systems and the IT infrastructure they run on – from PLCs and SCADA through to industrial networks, servers, virtualisation and cybersecurity. This is a hybrid role. You will be as comfortable configuring a managed switch or a Windows Server as you are online with a PLC or commissioning a SCADA screen. You will work alongside senior engineers on live client projects, building hands-on experience across the full OT stack. **Key responsibilities** **Automation and SCADA** * Support PLC and HMI/SCADA development, modification and fault-finding on Siemens platforms (TIA Portal, S7-1200/1500, WinCC). * Assist with SCADA upgrades and migrations, including WinCC and AVEVA/Wonderware InTouch systems. * Support integration of field devices over PROFINET – drives, valve terminals, IO, signal towers and instrumentation. * Help with FAT, SAT and on-site commissioning, including loop checks and IO testing. * Carry out backups, version control and change records for PLC and SCADA projects. **IT and infrastructure** * Build, patch and maintain Windows Server and workstation estates for SCADA, historian and engineering systems. * Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP and user access in OT domains, including OT/IT domain trusts. * Support Remote Desktop Services (RDS/RemoteApp) deployments for SCADA web and thin-client access. * Assist with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Intune administration for internal systems. * Support SQL Server instances used for historian, batch and reporting data – backups, maintenance and basic troubleshooting. * Assist with virtualisation platforms (Nutanix, HPE SimpliVity, VMware vSphere, Hyper-V) – VM builds, snapshots, health checks and host upgrades. **Networking and OT security** * Configure and maintain industrial Ethernet switches (Siemens SCALANCE XR/XRM/XC), including VLANs, redundancy and fibre links. * Support firewall, router and remote-access configurations for plant networks and outstations (e.g. Palo Alto, Fortinet, Siemens, Teltonika, site firewalls). * Use Siemens SINEC tools and standard diagnostics (Wireshark, ping/traceroute, Test-NetConnection) to troubleshoot connectivity. * Help implement network segmentation, zones and conduits, and secure remote access in line with IEC 62443 and NIS2. * Maintain asset registers, network diagrams and IP schedules. **Project delivery and documentation** * Produce and maintain client-facing technical documentation: functional specs, network drawings, IQ/OQ protocols, test scripts, SOPs and handover packs. * Support validation activities on GMP sites (GAMP 5, EU Annex 11 / 21 CFR Part 11 awareness). * Prepare BOMs and help with equipment selection for panels, networks and servers. * Keep accurate job records, timesheets and site reports. **Site support** * Provide first-line and scheduled support to client sites, both on-site and remotely. * Carry out preventative maintenance and periodic health checks on OT infrastructure. * Take part in planned out-of-hours shutdown work as needed. **Skills and experience** **Automation** **Essential** Basic PLC knowledge (ladder/FBD); understanding of IO, sensors and actuators **Desirable** Siemens TIA Portal, S7-1500, WinCC / WinCC Unified, InTouch; PROFINET device configuration **Networking** **Essential** TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, switching and routing fundamentals **Desirable** SCALANCE, SINEC NMS, industrial firewalls, fibre, ring redundancy (MRP/HRP) **Windows / IT** **Essential** Windows Server and client administration; Active Directory basics **Desirable** Group Policy, RDS, Entra ID / Intune, PowerShell scripting **Virtualisation** **Essential** Understanding of VMs and hypervisors **Desirable** Nutanix, HPE SimpliVity, VMware vSphere, Hyper-V **Databases** **Desirable** SQL Server administration and backups **Security** **Essential** Awareness of good security practice **Desirable** IEC 62443, NIS2, secure remote access, network segmentation **Regulated industry** **Desirable** Experience in pharma, dairy or food & beverage; GMP and validation documentation **Documentation** **Essential** Clear technical writing; confident with Word, Excel and Visio **Desirable** Writing IQ/OQ protocols and FDS documents **Qualifications** * Degree, Higher Certificate or apprenticeship in Electrical / Automation / Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Networking or a related discipline – or equivalent hands-on experience. * 2 - 5 years' experience in automation, IT infrastructure or networking (graduates with strong relevant project work will be considered). * Industry certifications are an advantage, e.g. Siemens TIA Portal training, CCNA / CompTIA Network+, Microsoft (AZ-800 / MD-102), VMware VCTA/VCP, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals. * Full clean driving license. * Valid Safe Pass (or willingness to obtain one). **Personal attributes** * Curious and eager to learn across both IT and automation disciplines. * Methodical approach to fault-finding – tests before assuming. * Organized and careful with change control, backups and records. * Comfortable working on live production sites with client operations and maintenance teams. * Good communicator who can explain technical issues to non-technical people. * Works well alone on site and as part of a small project team. **Working conditions** * Regular travel to client sites across Ireland; occasional overnight stays. * Site environments include production floors, washdown areas and GMP / cleanroom zones – PPE and site rules must be followed. * Occasional out-of-hours work during planned shutdowns and go-lives. **Development path** **First 3 months** Site inductions and safety training; shadowing senior engineers; supporting backups, documentation and network/server builds under supervision. **3–12 months** Independently handling routine site support, switch and server configuration, and PLC/SCADA changes with review; contributing to FAT/SAT and IQ/OQ execution. **12 months +** Leading smaller work packages end to end; progressing towards OT Automation Engineer, with funded vendor and security certification. **Package** * Competitive salary * Mileage allowance * Laptop, phone and PPE provided * Funded training and certification * Pension (After 1 Year) and annual leave

title: Product Designer
description: Take a mechanical problem on a drinks dispense system from the first brief to a working build, and solve it with your hands as much as your CAD. Design it in the morning, print it at lunch and test it in the afternoon, on a product headed for supermarket shelves around the world. You'll be joining a 30-year-old product design and R&D consultancy in Dublin, around 50 people working across FMCG, MedTech and pharma. Their value is making things work rather than making them look good, and their products sit on supermarket shelves around the world. The studio has tripled in size and now has its workshop, labs and in-house 3D printing under one roof. **The role** You'll join a 10 to 11 person programme developing a drinks dispense system for an FMCG client, with a lead above you and a graduate allocated to work alongside you. The core of the job is quick CAD in SolidWorks, printing parts in-house, testing, refining and going again. You'll propose the next step rather than wait to be told, give a short update at weekly reviews on what you've done and where you need help, and present to clients along the way. Products here reach shelves in four to six months, not fifteen years. It suits a technical designer who wants real mechanical problems to own and a measured route to senior. **What you'll need** * Proven experience designing physical products that went into production, with the mechanical and technical decisions sitting with you. * SolidWorks at a problem-solving level, using it to work out mechanisms and fixes yourself, not just to model what someone else has designed. * Hands-on prototyping, going quickly from CAD to 3D printed parts, then building, testing and iterating on what you learn. * Clear, early communication about your own work, including flagging when you're stuck and explaining the logic behind your decisions. **The details** * Reporting to the The programme lead, FMCG drinks dispense team * A graduate supporting your prototyping and testing * DCU Alpha campus, Glasnevin, with parking * Interview trip and first two weeks' stay covered * Right to work in Ireland, no visa sponsorship * Start: To be confirmed * Buddy, monthly catch-ups and CAD masterclasses * Skills matrix goals at three and twelve months * Merit-based route to senior **What it isn't** This isn't a styling role. How a product looks matters far less here than whether it works, so sketching and rendering won't carry you. It isn't remote or hybrid either. The work happens in the workshop, so you'll be on site in Dublin every day. And there's no formal relocation package, just your interview trip and first two weeks' accommodation. If you'd rather solve problems with a fresh print in your hand, that's the point. **If this sounds like your next move, click Apply and we'll be in touch.**
